TU_build_forts_1 = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = TU_build_forts_1_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { any_owned_state = { is_controlled_by = ROOT any_neighbor_state = { NOT = { is_owned_by = ROOT } } } }
			}
			capital_scope = {
				add_building_construction = {
					type = bunker
					level = 2
					instant_build = yes
					province = { all_provinces = yes }
				}
			}
		}
		random_owned_controlled_state = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_state_flag = TU_fort_done }
				any_neighbor_state = { NOT = { is_owned_by = ROOT } }
			}
			set_state_flag = TU_fort_done
			add_building_construction = {
				type = bunker
				level = 2
				instant_build = yes
				province = { all_provinces = yes limit_to_border = yes }
			}
		}
		every_owned_state = {
			limit = { has_state_flag = TU_fort_done }
			clr_state_flag = TU_fort_done
		}
	}
}

TU_build_coastal_forts_1 = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = TU_build_coastal_forts_1_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { any_owned_state = { is_controlled_by = ROOT is_coastal = yes } } }
			TU_build_forts_1 = yes
		}
		else = {
			random_owned_controlled_state = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_state_flag = TU_fort_done }
					is_coastal = yes
				}
				set_state_flag = TU_fort_done
				add_building_construction = {
					type = coastal_bunker
					level = 2
					instant_build = yes
					province = { all_provinces = yes limit_to_coastal = yes }
				}
			}
		}
		every_owned_state = {
			limit = { has_state_flag = TU_fort_done }
			clr_state_flag = TU_fort_done
		}
	}
}

			limit = { NOT = { any_owned_state = { is_controlled_by = ROOT is_coastal = yes } } }
			TU_build_forts_3 = yes
		}
		else = {
			random_owned_controlled_state = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_state_flag = TU_fort_done }
					is_coastal = yes
				}
				set_state_flag = TU_fort_done
				add_building_construction = {
					type = coastal_bunker
					level = 3
					instant_build = yes
					province = { all_provinces = yes limit_to_coastal = yes }
				}
			}
			random_owned_controlled_state = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_state_flag = TU_fort_done }
					is_coastal = yes
				}
				set_state_flag = TU_fort_done
				add_building_construction = {
					type = coastal_bunker
					level = 3
					instant_build = yes
					province = { all_provinces = yes limit_to_coastal = yes }
				}
			}
			random_owned_controlled_state = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_state_flag = TU_fort_done }
					is_coastal = yes
				}
				set_state_flag = TU_fort_done
				add_building_construction = {
					type = coastal_bunker
					level = 3
					instant_build = yes
					province = { all_provinces = yes limit_to_coastal = yes }
				}
			}
		}
		every_owned_state = {
			limit = { has_state_flag = TU_fort_done }
			clr_state_flag = TU_fort_done
		}
	}
}
